project.name: TypeSafe Core
project.description: The TypeSafe contract: the TypeSafeClient interface and its decorators (retries, deadline, token counting), TypeSafeException, the wire model, and the JsonCodec SPI. No dependencies. Every client-* module implements or builds on TypeSafeClient (client-http calls the API, client-local runs a model in-process); the model plus a codec-* module serializes TypeSafe payloads without any HTTP code, e.g. for a Kafka producer/consumer.
